case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests commonly praised the hotel's location near the beach and marina, generous breakfast offerings, pool and outdoor areas, comfortable beds and generally clean rooms, and friendly/helpful staff. Isolated or less frequent criticisms included dated infrastructure and noise, occasional unpleasant room odours, a problematic spa visit, limited plug sockets, coffee-machine jams causing queues, and some uncomfortable sun loungers.
